integrationChecklist: Normalize UID and VAT suffixes before storing company identifiers.
Treat AHV/AVS as sensitive personal data and mask it in logs.
Run Swiss IBAN MOD-97 locally, then use official bank or payment systems for ownership/status.
Keep QR-bill references and QR payloads layout-safe in forms and PDFs.
Store canton as a structured two-letter code when address, tax, payroll, or vehicle workflows need it.
Support de-CH, fr-CH, it-CH, and neutral API formats without localizing route slugs.

validationRules.name: AHV/AVS
validationRules.description: Thirteen digits beginning with 756 and using an EAN-style check digit.

validationRules.name: Swiss IBAN
validationRules.description: CH or LI plus 19 alphanumeric characters with ISO MOD-97 validation.

validationRules.name: QR reference

commonMistakes.title: Treating UID syntax as registry proof
commonMistakes.text: A valid-looking UID does not prove active company status.

commonMistakes.title: Logging AHV/AVS raw values
commonMistakes.text: Swiss social insurance numbers are sensitive and should be masked in diagnostics.

commonMistakes.title: Mixing locale separators
commonMistakes.text: Swiss German, French, Italian, and API numeric formats need explicit handling.

commonMistakes.title: Using raw QR payloads as select labels
commonMistakes.text: Long QR-bill payloads must stay inside inputs or local scroll containers.

developerNotes.title: Official-system boundary
developerNotes.text: Use ValidoHub for local evidence and official Swiss systems for legal status, identity proof, registry state, and tax filing.

developerNotes.title: Locale scope
developerNotes.text: Swiss production systems often need de-CH, fr-CH, it-CH, and neutral ISO/API formatting in the same product.

developerNotes.title: Payment data handling
developerNotes.text: QR-bill payloads, IBANs, references, and amount strings can become long; wrap and scroll locally.

developerExamples.code: const swissPayload = { locale: 'de-CH', uid: 'CHE-123.456.789 MWST', iban: 'CH9300762011623852957' };

localizationNotes.title: Language variants
localizationNotes.text: Use de-CH, fr-CH, and it-CH examples where customer-facing copy or address display depends on language.

localizationNotes.title: Currency
localizationNotes.text: CHF values can use apostrophe grouping in Swiss German contexts and should be normalized for APIs.

localizationNotes.title: Dates
localizationNotes.text: DD.MM.YYYY is common, while APIs should use ISO 8601.
